## 更新内容 / Changes

- 适配 Codex 桌面客户端 26.1027.61615 的打包启动入口及多层页面加载器，恢复 API 实例的页面语言、普通 / Fast 和 Ultra 推理菜单检测。
- 按实际启动依赖和功能结构检测兼容性，支持旧版分离入口与新版静态分块映射，不增加客户端版本白名单。资源读取有数量、大小和路径限制；结构不明确时保留原界面。
- 适配新版 Ultra 偏好设置，保留模型能力与独立账号偏好分支，并验证选择保存、页面刷新和继续对话。
- 减少语言检测对无关模块的重复解析。官方账号的原生桌面实例继续使用客户端原版界面，不进入菜单适配路径。

- Supports the bundled startup entry and layered renderer loader in Codex desktop 26.1027.61615, restoring language, Normal / Fast and Ultra reasoning detection for API instances.
- Determines compatibility from startup dependencies and feature structure, supporting both older split entries and static chunk maps without a client-version allowlist. Resource reads are bounded by path, size and count; ambiguous structures retain the original UI.
- Adapts the updated Ultra preference representation while preserving model capabilities and separate account preferences. Selection persistence, page reload and continued conversation were checked.
- Avoids repeated parsing of unrelated modules during locale detection. Native official-account instances continue using the original client UI outside the menu adaptation path.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）DMG / ZIP 和 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。有运行实例时保留后台服务，待工作结束、管理器完全退出后切换新版；账号、实例、会话与本地配置保留。未提供应用内自动更新、Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构未经验证。

DMG / ZIP and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64). Keep background services running during active work and switch after the manager fully exits; accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app auto-update, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures are not validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

延续 Codex 桌面 / CLI、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Desktop 支持，客户端需单独安装。本次改动集中在 Codex API 桌面兼容层。Fast 和 Ultra 的实际可用性仍取决于模型及服务商，未新增真实付费账号登录或上游模型服务的端到端验收。

Continues support for Codex desktop / CLI, Claude Code CLI and Claude Desktop, installed separately. This change targets the Codex API desktop compatibility layer. Actual Fast and Ultra availability still depends on the model and provider; no new real paid-account login or upstream model-service end-to-end verification is claimed.

## 验证来源 / Verification

使用真实 26.1027.61615 客户端、隔离目录、合成身份和本机模拟服务，验证中文页面、普通请求、Fast 的 `priority` 请求、Ultra 与原生 CLI 的请求语义一致，以及刷新后恢复 Ultra。合成回归覆盖新旧启动结构、歧义入口、路径与资源限制，以及偏好变量作用域。

Tested the real 26.1027.61615 client with disposable directories, synthetic identity and a local mock service: Chinese UI, normal requests, Fast `priority` requests, Ultra semantics matching the native CLI, and Ultra restoration after reload. Synthetic regressions cover old and new startup layouts, ambiguous entries, path/resource bounds and preference binding scope.

源码见 [v0.15.23 标签 / source tag](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/tree/v0.15.23)，构建见 [Build release](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/actions/workflows/release.yml)，安装包摘要见 [SHA256SUMS.txt](https://github.com/sv3nbeast/agent-manager-lite/releases/download/v0.15.23/SHA256SUMS.txt)。
